an8.42:1.1: Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato bhikkhave uposatho upavuttho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.42:1.2: Kathaṃ upavuttho ca bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro? 2.
an8.42:1.4: ‘yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharanti,
an8.42:1.5: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharāmi,
an8.42:1.6: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.42:1.7: Iminā paṭhamena aṅgena samannāgato hoti . . . pe . . . 3.
an8.42:2.1: ‘Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.42:2.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.42:2.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.42:2.5: Evaṃ upavuttho kho bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.42:3.1: Kīva mahapphalo hoti kīva mahānisaṃso kīva mahājutiko kīva mahāvipphāro? 4.
an8.42:3.2: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave yo imesaṃ soḷasannaṃ mahājanapadānaṃ pahūtasattaratanānaṃ issarādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreyya, seyyathīdaṃ
an8.42:3.3: Aṅgānaṃ Magadhānaṃ Kāsīnaṃ Kosalānaṃ Vajjīnaṃ Mallānaṃ Cetīnaṃ Vaṃsānaṃ Kurūnaṃ Pañcālānaṃ Macchānaṃ Sūrasenānaṃ Assakānaṃ Avantīnaṃ Gandhārānaṃ Kambojānaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an8.42:3.5: Kapaṇaṃ bhikkhave mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbasukhaṃ upanidhāya. 5.
an8.42:4.1: Yāni bhikkhave mānusakāni paññāsa vassāni, Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:4.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni pañca vassasatāni Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:4.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:4.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.42:5.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave mānusakaṃ vassasataṃ, Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:5.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:5.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:5.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.42:6.1: Yāni bhikkhave mānusakāni dve vassasatāni, Yāmānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:6.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni dve vassasahassāni Yāmānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:6.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:6.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.42:7.1: Yāni bhikkhave mānusakāni cattāri vassasatāni, Tusitānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:7.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni cattāri vassasahassāni Tusitānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:7.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:7.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.42:8.1: Yāni bhikkhave mānusakāni aṭṭha vassasatāni, Nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:8.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni aṭṭha vassasahassāni Nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:8.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:8.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.42:9.1: Yāni bhikkhave mānusakāni soḷasa vassasatāni, Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.42:9.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni soḷasa vassasahassāni Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.42:9.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.42:9.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.42:9.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbasukhaṃ upanidhāyā ti.
an8.42:10.1: Pāṇaṃ na haññe na cādinnam ādiye
an8.42:10.2: musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā
an8.42:11.1: mālaṃ na dhāraye na ca gandham ācare
an8.42:12.1: Cando ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā
an8.42:13.3: siṅgī suvaṇṇaṃ atha vā pi kañcanaṃ
an8.42:15.1: Tasmā hi nārī ca naro ca sīlavā
